meta.ephemeris: JPL DE421 (planets + lunar libration), frame PA->ME per SPICE moon_080317.tf; DE421-vs-IAU frame check < 0.06 deg
meta.dem: LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ resampled to 400 m (heightmap_1520.f32), sphere R=1737.4 km
meta.horizon: great-circle ray march, 200 m steps to 400 km (truncated at DEM edge), 0.5 deg azimuth bins
meta.sun_encoding: hex digit 0..f = fraction of solar disk above horizon x 15

analysis.method: highest DEM pixel on the 9-13 km ring around the IAU centre (rim crest)
